create_FBX_importer: create an FBX importer instance from a file path to extract meshes, skeleton, and animation data
load_motion_from_FBX: load a Motion object from an FBX file with optional bone name filtering and floor offset
extract_skinned_mesh: extract and combine all skinned meshes from an FBX file into a single unified mesh
inspect_FBX_structure: debug and print the node count, mesh count, joint names, and animation details of an FBX file
find_parent_in_hierarchy: find the nearest ancestor node of a given node that matches a list of candidate names
